sources.title: European Climate Neutrality Act
sources.author: European Parliament
sources.excerpt: By 2050, Europe shall achieve climate neutrality through renewable energy and rewilding.
sources.longExcerpt: The European Federation declares its commitment to full climate neutrality by 2050. Solar farms cover former agricultural lands. Wind turbines line every coast. The great forests have returned - wolves roam the Carpathians again, bears fish in pristine rivers. Cities are green, vertical farms rise between buildings. Transportation is electric or hydrogen-powered. This is not just policy but survival. The old world of fossil fuels is dead. We build the new world on its ashes.
